customer_acme: Hey team — since last night we're seeing intermittent 401s to the /v1/embeddings endpoint and then a bunch of downstream errors that say "dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024". This started ~02:00 UTC after a token rotation. Using embeddings TS SDK v0.9.2 with batchSize=8. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d.

sam_support: sorry about that, thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste a truncated request body (no PII) + the X-Request-ID header and the SDK config you used? Also are you behind any proxy or gateway?

customer_acme: here's the minimal request we used (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "open-embed-1536",
  "input": [[...1536 floats...], [...1536 floats...]],
  "batch_size": 8
}
```
Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <rotating-token>`, `X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d`. We're behind a light L7 gateway that does connection pooling.

sam_support: forwarding to eng @liam_eng @kevin_sdk — adding logs and timeline.

liam_eng: looking at infra logs: around 02:00 UTC we had several auth tokens rotated and the auth service returned transient 401 for ~90s. I see client retries from the customer in that window. Two suspicious correlations: (1) 401s spike, (2) immediately after a subset of embed responses are labeled with dimension 1024.

kevin_sdk: flagged — known potential class of bug: if the SDK reuses a typed array / buffer pool for batching performance, and a retry path or concurrent request returns a different model/dimension (due to token race or routed fallback), a stale buffer could be encoded into the next response parsing step. TS/Go SDKs both had a buffer-reuse optimization that requires strict reallocation on dimension change.

kevin_sdk: can you run this quick repro script? it toggles token to force rotation and sends batches concurrently. If you see mismatch, paste the console output.
```ts
// repro.ts (TS SDK v0.9.2)
import {EmbeddingsClient} from '@redwood/embed-sdk';
const c = new EmbeddingsClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, maxBatchSize: 8});
async function send(){
  const inputs = Array(8).fill(new Array(1536).fill(0.01));
  const res = await c.embed({model: 'open-embed-1536', input: inputs});
  console.log('dims', res.data.map(d=>d.embedding.length));
}
// run send() in a tight loop while toggling token in parallel
```

customer_acme: ran that under our gateway and reproduced — output: 
`dims [1536,1536,1024,1536,1536,1024,1536,1536]` — repeated twice. Attaching gateway logs showing two 401s right before the first 1024s.

kevin_sdk: confirmed, repro matches. Short-term workaround: set `maxBatchSize: 1` or disable connection pooling in the gateway so the SDK doesn't reuse a pooled buffer across a token-rotated flow. Long-term: we prepared a fix to ensure the SDK always re-allocates per-request if the returned embedding length doesn't match the expected shape. Patch is on a branch.

liam_eng: infrastructure note — we also saw a routing fallback during the auth outage where some requests were routed to a trimmed model variant (1024-dim) as a compatibility fallback when quota checks timed out. That explains the 1024 responses. We should avoid automatic model fallback for embeddings; opened infra ticket INF-827.

maya_devex: next steps for customer: 1) apply the SDK workaround (upgrade to 0.9.3-beta which includes the reallocation fix) or set maxBatchSize=1; 2) disable pooling on gateway while we push patch; 3) we'll schedule a canary of SDK patch with you. Also offer a temporary Dedicated trial if you want guaranteed model pins.

sam_support: creating internal incident INC-2026-345 and linking INF-827 + SDK-PR-142. @billing_bot can you check whether the customer's retries caused a billing spike?

billing_bot: logged potential overcharge window 2026-03-17T02:00-02:05UTC for account customer_acme. Opened billing investigation ticket BILL-501. Will prepare a provisional credit if confirmed.

kevin_sdk: quick patch notes we'll ship in 0.9.3: ensure TypedArray reallocation on dimension change, tighten concurrency checks, and add a defensive assertion when mixing models in the same batch. Also add better logging: `X-RW-Model-Dim` header on responses for easier correlation.

customer_acme: thanks — we'll try the beta and the gateway config change this morning and report back. Appreciate the quick triage.

ci-bot: deploy queued for sdk/0.9.3-beta -> canary. Track: PR #142, CI green.

sam_support: closing loop — please reopen if you see further mismatches after the upgrade. I'll follow up on the billing ticket once we have usage numbers. :thumbsup:
